title: Basics of the OpenDSS Scripting Language
scope: Explains text commands and script redirection. The page gives no OpenDSS release version.

title: OpenDSS Line element
scope: Describes Line impedance options, order, and length units. Use the pinned engine and wrapper for API units and defaults.

title: OpenDSS LineCode element
scope: Describes reusable impedance definitions, sequence properties, and capacitance units. Use pinned engine evidence for the circuit-dependent base frequency.

title: AltDSS engine context and text commands
scope: Defines isolated contexts and accepts a command string or a list of command strings.

title: AltDSS object lookup by name
scope: Defines collection lookup used by the DSS text example runner.

title: AltDSS LineCode creation
scope: Defines the creation signature, name argument, and edit context behavior.

title: AltDSS Line creation
scope: Defines the single object creation signature and edit context behavior.

title: AltDSS Line batch creation
scope: Documents batch creation by name and edit context behavior.

title: AltDSS Line batch property types
scope: Identifies supported scalar and list arguments for the selected batch properties.

title: DSS C-API Line implementation
scope: Read DefineProperties for specification sets, PropertySideEffects for reset behavior, and SetWires for conductor ordering.

title: DSS C-API LineCode implementation
scope: Read DefineProperties for property definitions and scales, and TLineCodeObj.Create for initial values.

title: AltDSS-Python 0.2.4 tagged changelog
scope: The 0.2.4 section records the engine update to 0.14.5. The preceding 0.2.3 section records changes to new, batch_new, and edit context behavior.

title: DSS-Python 0.15.7 release
scope: Release history for the pinned DSS-Python dependency. The release describes a LineGeometries fix in the engine.

title: DSS C-API 0.14.5 release
scope: Identifies the engine release and links its changelog and documentation on differences from EPRI OpenDSS.

title: dss-python-backend 0.14.5 distribution
scope: Identifies the Python distribution that carries the native engine and low-level bindings.
